The '''Eyeball Droid''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] armed with a [[rapid ion gun]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Eyeball Droid is an enemy in the [[Wikipedia:Super Nintendo Entertainment System|Super Nintendo]] videogame ''[[Super Star Wars]]''. Players first encounter them on "Level 3: Outside the Sandcrawler." These droids fly around the player while firing their rapid ion guns. These droids were also used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. ''[[Super Star Wars Official Game Secrets]]'' calls it an "Eyeball Droid."
